art_direction: 墨发绯墙：长鹅蛋脸略带柔和方形骨架、舒展长眼、适度高颧骨、圆润宽下巴和自然成年比例；墨蓝黑锁骨发与宝蓝上衣，绯橘拱墙、青绿海水和洋红花卉形成浓烈撞色。

textual_face_inspiration.role: Text-only inspiration for elongated eyes, cheekbone-to-jaw structure and relaxed adult expression; original illustrated character.

composition_variation: Head-to-waist editorial anime portrait, gentle shoulder angle and near-frontal gaze, larger natural-proportion face, no hand prop.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved outside the repository in Codex task artifact directory jewel-face-redesign/native. Canonical wallpaper is cropped and resized.

wallpaper.hair: Ink-black collarbone-length side-parted hair with deep blue highlights
wallpaper.title: 墨发绯墙 · 舒展东方骨相
wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Inspected compressed 589x1280 JPEG of canonical wallpaper. Distinct adult face with elongated almond eyes, moderate iris size, fuller natural lips, visible nose planes and rounded jaw-to-chin contour. Ink-black collarbone bob, gold hoop earring and opaque blue top. The rendering is semi-realistic hand-painted anime/editorial portraiture, with a large legible face, coherent shoulder and neck anatomy, cyan sea/sky, coral wall and magenta flowers. No visible hands, text, watermark or additional people.

visible_description: 墨黑锁骨短发女性穿宝蓝上衣侧身望向镜头，舒展长眼、清晰颧骨与圆润下颌呈现成熟骨相；青蓝海天、绯橘墙与洋红花枝构成近景肖像背景。
